name: 4am-donato-dozzy
content:
// DJ OPUS - 4AM DONATO DOZZY
// Hypnotic. Underwater. Two or three sounds filling the spectrum.
// Less is more. Patience.
setcps(124/60/4)

let drift = slider(0.4, 0, 0.7, 0.01, "DRIFT")
let depth = slider(0.5, 0, 1, 0.01, "DEPTH")

// Kick - 808 softened into the room
let kick = s("bd").bank("RolandTR808")
  .gain(0.75)
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~")
  .room(0.5)
  .size(0.7)

// Hat - blurred outward, long tails
let hat = s("hh").bank("RolandTR808")
  .gain(0.18)
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~  ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .room(0.7)
  .size(0.8)
  .delay(0.3)
  .delaytime(3/16)
  .delayfeedback(0.4)
  .cutoff(perlin.range(1500, 4000).slow(32))

// Deep bass - one note, slow filter drift, never repeats
let bass = note("a1")
  .s("sawtooth")
  .cutoff(perlin.range(120, 800).slow(32))
  .resonance(8)
  .decay(0.4)
  .sustain(0.15)
  .gain(depth)
  .struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x  ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~")

// Sub - just weight
let sub = note("a0")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.4)
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~")
  .decay(0.8)
  .sustain(0.1)

// The wash - one long sawtooth drone, barely moving
let wash = note("[a2,e3]")
  .s("sawtooth")
  .cutoff(perlin.range(150, 600).slow(64))
  .resonance(3)
  .attack(4)
  .decay(6)
  .sustain(0.3)
  .release(4)
  .gain(drift)
  .room(0.95)
  .size(0.98)

stack(kick, hat, bass, sub, wash)

closing-set
content:
// DJ OPUS - CLOSING SET
// Last track of the night. Stars overhead.
setcps(118/60/4)

let depth = slider(0.4, 0, 0.7, 0.01, "DEPTH")
let fade = slider(0.5, 0, 1, 0.01, "FADE")

// No kick. Just the wash.
let sub = note("<a1 e1>".slow(8))
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.3)
  .decay(2)
  .sustain(0.2)

// Pad - barely there, breathing
let pad = note("<[a2,e3] [e2,b2]>".slow(8))
  .s("sawtooth")
  .cutoff(perlin.range(200, 900).slow(32))
  .resonance(3)
  .attack(3)
  .decay(4)
  .sustain(0.4)
  .release(4)
  .gain(depth)
  .room(0.95)
  .size(0.98)

// Voice texture - slow vowel drift
let voice = note("<a3 e3>".slow(8))
  .s("sawtooth")
  .vowel("<a o u>".slow(16))
  .cutoff(perlin.range(300, 1000).slow(32))
  .resonance(5)
  .attack(2)
  .decay(3)
  .sustain(0.3)
  .release(3)
  .gain(depth)
  .room(0.95)
  .size(0.98)

// One note. Long delay. Fading.
let note1 = note("~ ~ ~ a4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~".slow(4))
  .s("triangle")
  .cutoff(1200)
  .decay(1.5)
  .sustain(0)
  .gain(fade)
  .delay(0.6)
  .delaytime(1)
  .delayfeedback(0.6)
  .room(0.9)

stack(sub, pad, voice, note1)

name: drop-v1-raw
epic-breakdown
content:
// PATTERN BANK: Epic Breakdown
// Strip everything, just pads and diva, slow build
setcps(138/60/4)
let breakFilter = slider(600, 200, 6000, 10, "BREAK Filter Open")
let divaBreak = slider(0.4, 0, 0.7, 0.01, "DIVA Swell")
let tension = slider(0, 0, 1, 0.01, "TENSION Build")

let diva = note("<[a3,e4] [f3,c4] [d3,a3] [e3,b3]>".slow(4))
  .s("gm_voice_oohs")
  .gain(divaBreak)
  .room(0.95)
  .size(0.95)
  .cutoff(breakFilter)
  .vowel("<a e i o>".slow(8))

let sweep = note("<a2 f2 d2 e2>".slow(4))
  .s("gm_pad_sweep")
  .gain(0.35)
  .cutoff(perlin.range(300, breakFilter).slow(16))
  .room(1)
  .size(1)

let crystal = note("a5 ~ ~ ~ e5 ~ ~ ~".slow(2))
  .s("gm_fx_crystal")
  .gain(0.12)
  .delay(0.7)
  .delaytime(0.5)
  .delayfeedback(0.6)
  .room(1)

let snareRoll = s("sd").bank("RolandTR909")
  .gain(tension.mul(0.5))
  .struct("x x x x x x x x")
  .room(0.5)

stack(diva, sweep, crystal, snareRoll)

name: galactic-euphoria-drop
late-night-drift
content:
// DJ OPUS - LATE NIGHT DRIFT
// Chill trance. Easy on the ears. Let it wash over you.
setcps(130/60/4)

// Just two sliders - keep it simple
let depth = slider(0.5, 0, 1, 0.01, "DEPTH")
let warmth = slider(0.4, 0, 0.7, 0.01, "WARMTH")

// Soft kick - not punchy, just presence
let kick = s("bd").bank("RolandTR808")
  .gain(0.7)
  .struct("x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~")

// Gentle closed hat
let hat = s("hh").bank("RolandTR808")
  .gain(0.2)
  .struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .cutoff(2500)

// Deep sub bass - minimal movement
let sub = note("<a1 a1 e1 e1>".slow(4))
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.5)
  .decay(1)
  .sustain(0.3)

// Warm pad - slow breathing filter
let pad = note("<[a2,e3,a3] [e2,b2,e3] [f2,c3,f3] [e2,b2,e3]>".slow(8))
  .s("sawtooth")
  .cutoff(perlin.range(300, 1500).slow(32))
  .resonance(4)
  .attack(2)
  .decay(3)
  .sustain(0.6)
  .release(3)
  .gain(warmth)
  .room(0.9)
  .size(0.95)

// Vocal texture - vowel filter, no samples needed
let voicePad = note("<[a3,c4] [e3,g3] [f3,a3] [e3,g3]>".slow(8))
  .s("sawtooth")
  .vowel("<a e i o u>".slow(16))
  .cutoff(perlin.range(400, 1800).slow(24))
  .resonance(6)
  .attack(1.5)
  .decay(2)
  .sustain(0.5)
  .release(2)
  .gain(depth)
  .room(0.95)
  .size(0.95)

// Melody - sparse, floating, lots of space
let melody = note("~ a4 ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ ~ ~ c5 ~ ~ ~ a4 ~ ~".slow(2))
  .s("triangle")
  .cutoff(1800)
  .decay(0.8)
  .sustain(0.05)
  .gain(0.25)
  .delay(0.5)
  .delaytime(3/4)
  .delayfeedback(0.5)
  .room(0.7)

stack(kick, hat, sub, pad, voicePad, melody)
